title_zh: 先整理儿童读物并分开放待检查书籍

scenario.label_zh: 分拣捐赠图书的首轮工作
scenario.goal_zh: 确定先整理儿童读物，把有松页的书单独留待检查

context_zh: 图书义卖前，两位志愿者处理刚收到的捐赠书。
author: author-phase08-c

sentences.speaker: Chloe
sentences.text: Shall I put this whole pile on the sale table?

sentences.speaker: Arun
sentences.text: Not yet. We're sorting children's books first because the morning visitors are primarily families.

sentences.speaker: Chloe
sentences.text: Some of these have loose pages. Should I put them aside?

sentences.speaker: Arun
sentences.text: Yes, in the box marked 'check'. Don't put a price on them until someone has looked through them.

sentences.speaker: Chloe
sentences.text: I'll separate those and start arranging the children's books by age.

sentences.speaker: Arun
sentences.text: Thanks. I'll clear a table so you have room.
